races.display_title: Happy 80th Birthday William 'Bill' Carr Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: GREEN STAR 's latest Redcar fourth was underwhelming but he sets the standard on his opening Chester second prior to that and is given another chance from the inside stall under Buick. races.verdict: A huge field but SPIRIT LEAD ME capitalised on a much-reduced mark at Southwell 11 days ago and while he may not have shown form on turf for some time, Richard Hughes' charge is difficult to resist from this mark. Dalmally got up late on to gain a first handicap success at Brighton last time, so he's feared most now back in the groove, with Sub Thirteen and stable-switcher Sceptic rounding off the shortlist. SPIRIT LEAD ME (IRE) DALMALLY SUB THIRTEEN

races.verdict: Quite a few arrive in form but Irish raider LETHIMFLY does still stand out as being well treated having dipped to 12 lb lower than when second at Dundalk earlier in the year. His draw isn't ideal but he shaped as if back in form last time and is preferred to Invincible Crown , Blue Force and Oisin Murphy's mount Little Jaybee . LETHIMFLY (IRE) INVINCIBLE CROWN (IRE) BLUE FORCE (IRE)

races.verdict: REAL PETITE won over this C&D in June and, though her form dipped in mid-summer, she has bounced back with 2 encouraging efforts here. She seems sure to go close off a career-low mark, with Kingcharles feared most back at 1m if belatedly building on his Navan run and Arizona Star a player if this becomes enough of a stamina test. REAL PETITE (GER) KINGCHARLES (FR) ARIZONA STAR (IRE)
